(1) addrOf(k) = target address if k is the selected target cluster else Episode(other, OtherSpecific). Unattached = 0.55 Unresolved + addrOf(current); Ambiguous = 0.4 Unresolved + 0.5·addrOf(0) + 0.5·addrOf(current). Foil: "The birthday cake had candles." after Montreal — Unattached cluster can win the target; mode stays Unresolved and competitor mass is the materialized TargetSpecific (~0.45), not Unresolved 1.0.

(2) Fixture honesty: original "Then the waiter…" restored. BirthdayInterviewSuite now asserts waiter + embarrassment as Unattached (Unresolved-primary, targetMass < 0.5); pre-digression rain/fog stay target; cake visuals Unattached; expectedInternal > 0 but expectedExternal > expectedInternal (Unattached cake chain is counted external — honest, not a scoring bug); mentalStateProfile has no Emotion because profile mental states are target-mass gated. Separate case: Anyway on that waiter sentence → TargetSpecific.

(3) PlacementBasis.Seed for cluster-0 default. ContinuityStay only after ClusterContinuity.holds.
